newsitem.title: GERMANY: German DAX closes bourse firm but off highs.
newsitem.headline: German DAX closes bourse firm but off highs.

text.p: 1147 GMT - German shares end bourse firmer but off highs as dealers note investor unwillingness to fully reflect overnight rally in the Dow Jones. Bundesbank as widely expected leaves key rates unchanged. Dollar drifts against the mark in anticipation of further U.S. data due today.
* DAX-30 index of leading shares closes up 54.88 points at 3,434.07, off earlier levels of around 3,450. June DAX futures up 7.0 points to 3,438.0.
* BHW shares move up with market, pushing ahead of issue price.
* Mobilcom up after Q1 profit statement.
